metadata.title: Weak reducibility for bridge trisections
metadata.abstract: A bridge splitting of a knot is weakly reducible if it has a pair of disjoint shadows, one from above and one from below, in the splitting surface. The process of weak reduction exchanges local minima and maxima in the splitting, untelescoping the splitting and giving a method for detecting essential surfaces in the knot complement. Bridge trisections generalize bridge splittings to the setting of surfaces in 4-manifolds. We define weak reducibility in this context, giving diagrammatic conditions for carrying out a weak reduction operation on bridge splittings. We produce a partial classification of 4-bridge trisections of surfaces in $S^4$.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 将结桥分裂的弱约化思想推广到四流形中曲面桥三分，给出可操作的图示条件，并对 S⁴ 中四桥三分给出部分分类。
analysis.breakthrough: 提供在曲面结分解中仿照三维桥分裂的简化机制。
analysis.limitations: 分类是部分结果，不能读作所有四桥曲面或所有桥三分的完整分类。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。第2页明确声明未使用生成式 AI；作者用 Mathcha 制图，普通编辑软件不计为 AI。

analysis.priorityReason: 适合曲面结及四维分解方向专题阅读。
